mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the balance organs to the outgoing nerve routes was most worthwhile: it showed how sensing a head turn relates to keeping your eyes on a point.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the turning sensors to incoming nerves felt like a small intermediate step; it didn't yet show how the eyes respond.

surprise.text: The weighted sensors also respond when straight-line movement changes, not just when the head tilts.

arbitrary.text: No action felt pointless, though combining the two sensor systems was the only offered move and I wasn't sure beforehand how their nerve connections would be shown.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter. The final model connected a familiar experience—keeping my eyes on something while turning my head—to the sensors I built.
